Hong Kong: Chief Executive John Lee, meeting Shanghai mayor Zhu Zhongming on a Shanghai visit Friday, named the Shanghai Futures Exchange for the first time as a hoped-for gold-hub partner, alongside the Shanghai Gold Exchange already in the clearing system, due Q1 2027.

香港：行政長官李家超上海訪問期間會見上海市市長朱忠明，首次提到期望香港加強與上海期貨交易所合作，與早已連結本港黃金清算系統的上海黃金交易所並列；清算系統仍計劃於2027年首季正式啟用。

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Gold in Hong Kong: HK$38,222 a tael, HK$1,021 a gram, silver HK$13,036 a kilogram — an intraday mark from the tape, 6 November 04:59 EST.
